impact.text: the accounting stays balanced, just with permanently frozen funds.

precondition_sources.text: A user calls requestRedeem, transferring their USDM to the vault and incrementing totalOwed in RedeemEscrow via addObligation.
The operator calls fundRedemptions to move the matching USDC into the escrow.
The redeeming user is blacklisted by Circle between requestRedeem and claimRedeem.

intent_sources.text: payOut must be able to reduce totalOwed for an obligation so the corresponding USDC can be reclaimed.
The user's USDM transferred at requestRedeem must be burnable or returnable via a refund path.
